name: Bundle
description: Tier card shown in the #bundles section (Starter 2 / Most popular 3 / Whole home 5). Prices and savings come live from the referenced products.

field_definitions.name: Tag / badge
field_definitions.description: Flag above the title, e.g. "Starter 2", "Most popular 3", "Whole home 5". Empty hides it.

field_definitions.name: Products
field_definitions.description: Products in the tier, in display order. Quantity shown on the card is computed from this list.

field_definitions.name: Bullets
field_definitions.description: Per-product / benefit bullet list rendered on the card.

field_definitions.name: CTA label
field_definitions.description: Button label, e.g. "Buy this bundle". Falls back to a sensible default when empty.
